title: Forgot password
intro: Enter your address and we will send you a reset link.
sent: If an account exists for this address, a reset link has just been sent to it. It can be used once and expires after 30 minutes.
sendError: Could not send. Please try again.
resetIntro: Choose a password for your account.
passwordRule: At least 10 characters, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
weakPassword: The password must be at least 10 characters long, with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
resetDone: Password changed. You can now sign in.
